landing.does.title: Built for food trucks, not restaurants.
landing.does.lede: Most ordering systems assume a fixed address, reliable wifi and the same hours every week. You’re somewhere new every week, at different times, on patchy or no mobile coverage. HatchGrab was built for that.
landing.does.capacityBody: Set how much you can cook at once, and how long it takes. Once a collection time is full, customers can’t pick it.
landing.does.devicesBody: Runs on the phone in your apron, the tablet on the counter, the laptop in the van — and the card machine you already take payment on.
landing.does.postsBody: Upload the design you already post on Facebook or Instagram. We’ll fill in your dates, places and times, ready to share — every week or every day.
landing.does.whatsappBody: “Where are you tonight?” “What desserts do you have?” Your WhatsApp gets answered while you’re driving to the pitch or at the grill, using your own menu and schedule. Messenger and Instagram coming soon.
landing.does.whatsappSoonBody: “Where are you tonight?” “What desserts do you have?” Soon your WhatsApp will get answered while you’re driving to the pitch or at the grill. Messenger and Instagram to follow.
landing.does.offlineBody: If you lose signal, online ordering pauses automatically so customers can’t place orders you won’t see. Carry on taking orders with the iPhone, iPad and Android app.
landing.does.slotsBody: Customers order ahead and pick a collection time. Fewer queues, and food ready when they arrive.
landing.steps.title: Get set up and start taking orders in about 15 minutes.
landing.steps.lede: Three things to sort — and two of them just need a photo.
landing.steps.menuBody: Photograph your board or paste it in. Items, prices and extras all come across on their own. You just check they’re right.
landing.steps.scheduleBody: Got it on your website? We’ll read it from there and keep it up to date. If not, photograph that too. You just approve what it finds.
landing.steps.shareBody: Post it on Facebook, stick the QR on the van. Orders land on your screen, in the order you need to cook them.
landing.testimonial.quote: HatchGrab has made ordering so much easier. Everything's organised, we can track stock and know exactly how many pizzas we have left to sell — and the time slots are fantastic for busy villages.

aboutPage.title: Built around the way food trucks actually work
aboutPage.story.start: HatchGrab started with a simple observation: food trucks need better tools to run their businesses.
aboutPage.story.villageFoodie: After creating Village Foodie, a directory helping people discover food trucks visiting their local area, I spent more time learning about the challenges mobile food businesses face. Unlike traditional restaurants, food trucks are constantly moving, working at different locations and serving customers in changing conditions.
aboutPage.story.fixedAddress: Yet much of the software available to them is designed around businesses with a fixed address.
aboutPage.story.change: HatchGrab was created to change that.
aboutPage.story.build: We build practical software specifically for food trucks and mobile caterers, helping them take online orders, manage collection times, keep orders flowing smoothly and spend less time dealing with repetitive questions.

featuresPage.detail.kitchen_app: The fullest way to run HatchGrab: a live kitchen screen, plus the only way to keep taking orders when you lose signal.

featuresPage.detail.offline_protection: If you lose signal, online ordering pauses so customers can’t place orders you won’t see. The iPhone, iPad and Android app keeps you taking orders offline; the web dashboard needs a connection.

featuresPage.detail.web_dashboard: Run your service from any phone, tablet or laptop browser.
featuresPage.detail.meal_deals_upsells: Bundle items into deals and offer add-ons at checkout to lift the average order.
featuresPage.detail.sold_out_toggle: Mark any item sold out in one tap — it greys out for customers straight away.
featuresPage.detail.stock_countdown: Set a stock count and it counts down as orders come in, then sells out automatically.

comparison.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
comparison.faq.whatQ: What is a food truck ordering system?
comparison.faq.whatA: An ordering system takes orders online before customers reach the truck: they choose dishes and a collection time, pay online or on collection, and the order appears in your kitchen. A till or card machine takes payment at the truck. The two complement each other.
comparison.faq.costA: {plans}. Online card payments also carry Stripe’s fees: {cardFee} per card payment.
comparison.faq.termA: No. There is no minimum term and no notice period. You can cancel any time; the fee is billed monthly in advance, and you keep access until the end of the month you have paid for.
comparison.faq.locationsQ: Does it work with changing locations?
comparison.faq.locationsA: Yes. You set up your weekly schedule with places and times, and customers order for the place and the day you are there.
comparison.faq.capacityQ: How does the system stop my kitchen being overloaded?
comparison.faq.capacityA: Customers only see collection times your kitchen can actually make. The system works from each dish's preparation time and how many you prepare at once.
comparison.faq.tseQ: Do I still need a till with a TSE?
comparison.faq.tseA: HatchGrab is not a till and has no TSE. How you record online orders in your till is a question for your tax adviser.
comparison.faq.paymentsQ: Which payment methods does HatchGrab support?
comparison.faq.paymentsA: Customers pay online by card, Apple Pay or Google Pay, or pay at the truck. PayPal and Klarna are not supported at the moment.
